title: an Orca failure on the close is exit 3 with the message, and the launch is not ended
source: cli/jitso/close.test.ts: 'an orca failure exits 3 with the message'
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES R1, defect N-28). A close that fails leaves the launch running: the footer and the end event are written only after the terminal is closed and `terminal list` no longer shows it, so a failure writes neither `footer.txt` nor an end event and a later close retries cleanly. The oracle writes the footer and the end event before it closes the terminal, so the registry count and the footer expectation FAIL on TS.
